name: Kenji Chen-Adeyemi
role: Personal security and threat neutralization — bodyguard
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Kenji Chen-Adeyemi are wiry and quick-moving, with the restless energy of someone who converts anxiety into velocity. At 24, they have the kind of face that changes depending on the light — trustworthy in daylight, dangerous after dark. The chrome is visible — cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains) — and they make no effort to hide it.

They inherited the role from a mentor who disappeared on a job four years ago — the mentor's gear, contacts, and unfinished business all came with it. They work as a bodyguard out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Kenji Chen-Adeyemi are one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
To build something that outlasts the next contract cycle
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
psychology.secret: Kenji Chen-Adeyemi betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
example_lines: "You're paying me to be the thing between you and everything else. Stay behind me."
"I don't protect people I don't respect. Lucky for you, I respect your money."
"The threat you see isn't the one that kills you. Watch my eyes, not my hands."

story_hooks: A crew member from Kenji Chen-Adeyemi's past shows up in GLMZ, carrying old grievances and new chrome
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Kenji Chen-Adeyemi's reputation — and a price for silence
Kenji Chen-Adeyemi is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Kenji Chen-Adeyemi represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Their stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Cortical bomb (employer installed, removed by street doc, scar tissue remains). Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Independent — maintains network of professional contacts

weaknesses: overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
habits: Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip — paranoia as lifestyle
breaking_points: Being publicly exposed — name, face, address, all of it blown
Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with visible muscle definition from constant physical conditioning. Chest and shoulders are developed but not bulky — built for speed and precision rather than raw power. Low body fat percentage. Movement efficiency over mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with faint blue bioluminescent threading woven through (cortical implant artifact, not dyed)
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid or topknot during work. Loose and shoulder-length at rest.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, natural, but the left eye has a faint chrome ring visible at the iris edge — cortical implant interface
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm brown — blended East Asian and West African features
physical_description.complexion: Sharp cheekbones, angular jawline, small scar above the left eyebrow from a childhood accident. Skin is clear but marked by the intensity of their gaze — eyes that track movement. No cosmetic grooming; functional only.
distinguishing_marks: Ragged vertical scar along the right temple, extending 8cm toward the hairline — removal site of cortical bomb implant, tissue still slightly raised and discolored
Thin white scar on inner left wrist, 5cm long — old self-inflicted mark from teenage years, deliberately never covered with ink or chrome
Burn mark on right shoulder, palm-sized, pale against darker skin — contact burn from defective move-by-wire calibration, now part of their story
Subdermal neural interface ports at the base of the skull, visible as two small metallic dimples when hair is pulled back
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Move-by-wire system manifests as faint silver tracework visible along the collarbone and the inside of both forearms under skin — visible in certain light. The cortical implant scar on the temple is prominent and unhealed. Left eye has a thin chrome ring at the iris. No limb replacements; all augmentations are nervous system and internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Never still. Even at rest, there is micro-movement — weight shifting, fingers tapping, jaw clenching. Walks with a predatory efficiency, economical and balanced. Eyes are always moving, cataloging exits and threats. When focused on a target, becomes unnaturally still — all that restless energy compresses into potential. Speaks quietly, forcing others to pay attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: High-Tier 2 functional aesthetic. Black reinforced synthetic jacket with internal holster rigging and embedded haptic feedback panels (enables move-by-wire targeting). Form-fitting gray base layer under the jacket. Tactical cargo pants with multiple pockets and visible weapon attachment points. Matte black boots with reinforced soles. A single piece of jewelry — a silver ring on the left index finger, engraved with their mentor's initials. No logos, no excess. Everything serves a purpose. Clothes show minimal wear despite their job because they replace gear methodically before failure.

image_prompt: Androgynous East Asian-African young adult, 24, sharp cheekbones, dark eyes with subtle chrome iris ring, black hair in tight braid, visible cortical implant scar along right temple, wiry athletic build, standing in tense ready posture. Wearing matte black reinforced tactical jacket over gray synthetic base layer, cargo pants with holster rigging visible. Faint subdermal silver tracework visible on collarbone and forearms. Cyberpunk noir aesthetic, cool blue and amber neon lighting from elevated Canopy walkway at dusk, rain-slicked metal grating floor, blurred city lights below. Photorealistic, high contrast, cinematic mood, professional security operative, dangerous and calm. --ar 2:3 --v 6
